goal: Safely reach full deployment when evidence supports the canary, avoid unnecessary rollback, and escalate when automation lacks sufficient authority or evidence.

enabledChoices.description: Keep the current traffic percentage and gather another observation window because the evidence may be noisy or incomplete.
Return traffic to the stable version because the evidence indicates a canary regression. High-risk rollbacks require human review instead.
Pause automation and request human review because evidence conflicts, legal automated actions are exhausted, or the remaining action risk is too high.
